training_source: Public SER head trained on nine named corpora including JL-Corpus and Emozionalmente; Whisper-v3 pretraining incompletely disclosed; author nEMO threshold calibration is counted as seen development use, although its thresholds are not applied here

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each actor was asked to portray, from the file name (`ANG`, `DIS`, `FEA`, `HAP`, `NEU`, `SAD`)
columns.listener_vote: the majority vote of crowd-sourced listeners who heard the voice only (`summaryTable.csv`, `VoiceVote`); a tie counts every tied emotion; 'a or b' is a tie
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 6 emotions evaluated (angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 7 model classes
columns.correct_acted_or_listener: whether prediction equals acted_emotion or the listener_vote (any emotion of a tie)
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 7 classes (they add up to 1)
